title: Output from the initial true state
statement: For every finite Boolean word $w$, the one-pass transducer whose state is a bit, whose transition sends $(q,b)$ to $q \vee \neg b$, and which emits the input bit $b$ exactly when the state is true produces $w$ when started in the true state.
hypotheses_covered: Input is a finite Boolean word
